svg.text: Rigged press sedan · Mona Vane — contestant vehicle dossier
“The light was perfect. That’s the part no one forgives.”
Flashbulbs strung like teeth — the “Flashbulb” special
The same photograph, over and over, on the glass
A red darkroom bulb glows in the cab
A boat-like 1961 black sedan studded with a
homemade rig of large flashbulbs strung like
teeth, cameras heaped in the back, the windows
papered with one repeated photograph, a red
darkroom glow inside, noir and unsettling,
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~50k tris · PBR 4K
